Warlock Fixed issues that caused some warlock summons and Diabolic Occuli to sometimes incorrectly target enemies outside of combat. Items Fixed an issue that caused items upgraded with Ascendant Venomstones to have incorrect item levels. items.summary: Class Tuning Incoming - October 27 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) The following class adjustments will arrive with scheduled weekly maintenance (October 27 in this region). Class Changes Druid Feral All damage done increased by 5%. Does not affect PvP combat. Restoration Developer’s note: These changes are intended to help Restoration Druid deal with burst damage in dungeons, as they are behind other healers. They are performing well in raid settings, so we are targeting talents and abilities that are favored when healing a 5-person group. Verdancy healing increased by 60%. Does not affect PvP combat. Regrowth healing increased by 10%. Does not affect PvP combat. Improved Swiftmend increases Swiftmend healing by 40% (was 30%). Does not affect PvP combat. Hunter Marksmanship Developers’ notes: These changes are intended to boost the area damage effectiveness of Marksmanship Hunters. Trick Shots now increases the ricochet damage of Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire by 85% (was 75%). Explosive Shot damage increased by 10%. Volley damage increased by 10%. Mage Fire All damage done increased by 5%. Does not affect PvP combat. Rogue Subtlety Developers’ notes: The buff Subtlety received as compensation alongside changes in the 12.1.5 patch overshot expectations, so we’re rolling back a significant portion of that buff. items.title: Thank You For Testing the WoW Forever Beta
items.summary: Thank You For Testing the WoW Forever Beta Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) The WoW Forever Beta is now closed, and we’re incredibly grateful to everyone who joined us over the last five weeks of playtesting, data gathering, bug reporting, and feedback. We’re now quickly moving into a period of a few short days where we will do some focused work on priority issues and the game service itself, so that it will be in good shape for launch day on November 4. And of course, we’ll open access to the character creation system on Tuesday, October 27, allowing everyone plenty of time to select the ruleset that will define your journey and snag the name that best fits your adventurer. You won’t have to wait until the game launches to make these big decisions. Also next week, we’re going to continue with our WoW Forever Podcast. If you haven’t consumed it all, this is a great time to catch up with everything the WoW Forever designers have had to say. items.summary: The WoW Forever Beta Celebration is Underway Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) The WoW Forever Beta will end 24 hours from now, at 10:00 a.m. PDT on Friday, October 23, and until that fateful moment, we’re celebrating the joy and wonder of WoW Forever with 24 hours of shenanigans and upheaval in Zephras Isle, Dun Morogh, Elwynn Forest, Teldrassil, Durotar, Tirisfal Glades, and Mulgore. Log into the WoW Forever Beta for one last time and head to one of those zones to experience the madness, and join us in saying goodbye to the Beta. Please note: Shenanigans and upheaval in this one-time-only celebration almost certainly include items and experiences that will not be a part of WoW Forever after it launches on November 4. We hope everyone has fun on this last day of the WoW Forever Beta. Thank you so much for testing the game with us! items.title: The Roleplay-PvP Ruleset is Coming to WoW Forever
items.summary: The Roleplay-PvP Ruleset is Coming to WoW Forever Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Greetings, In a recent episode of the WoW Forever Podcast we discussed some of our concerns with adding a Roleplay-PVP ruleset in WoW Forever, but we also mentioned that we were still discussing the topic internally and watching player feedback. Over the last few days, we’ve carefully examined what it would take to add it to WoW Forever and decided to go for it. We will add a Roleplay-PVP Ruleset for launch on November 4. We’re also working hard to make it so that you can select the Roleplay-PvP ruleset and reserve names there next week when our Name Reservation period begins on Tuesday, October 27. We really appreciate the feedback and comments on this. Thank you!

items.title: Gather Around the Campfire in World of Warcraft: Forever
items.summary: Gather Around the Campfire in World of Warcraft: Forever Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) There is something special about seeing another adventurer on the road. Maybe they are headed toward the same quest objective, recovering after a close fight, or simply taking the long way through a dangerous zone. In World of Warcraft: Forever, the Camping system gives those moments more room to grow by turning a simple Cooking Fire into a place where players can rest, prepare, and connect. The system expands the Cooking profession’s simple Cooking Fire into a Basic Campfire. Once placed, the Basic Campfire creates a shared campsite where nearby players can rest and gain benefits from profession-made camp features before setting out again. Those reasons to linger can turn a roadside pause into a helpful encounter, a trading opportunity, or the start of new friendships. Camp Features give professions a more visible role in the world . A Basic Campfire can support up to three special crafted objects contributed by nearby players, with each player able to add one. Each profession brings its own form of utility, such as a blacksmith placing a Sharpening Wheel that increases Strength for an hour, a tailor placing a Faction Banner that increases Spirit, or an herbalist placing an Incense Candle that increases Intellect. items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever Raid Overview - Locations, Raid Sizes and Attunement
items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever Raid Overview - Locations, Raid Sizes and Attunement Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) World of Warcraft: Forever invites adventurers to journey deeper into Azeroth, where familiar places hold new challenges and stories waiting to be discovered. On December 9, level 60 players can put their preparation, teamwork, and mastery of their classes to the test in three raids: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit, and Onyxia’s Lair. Raid Quick Facts The Barrow Deeps Location: Within Mount Hyjal, with multiple entrances connected through Mount Hyjal, Winterspring, and Blackmaw Hold Level: 60 Raid Size: 10 players Hyjal Summit Location: Summit of Mount Hyjal near the World Tree Nordrassil Level: 60 Raid Size: 20 players Onyxia’s Lair Location: Dustwallow Marsh Level: 60 Raid Size: 40 players Descend into The Barrow Deeps Hidden beneath Kalimdor, the Barrow Deeps is a maximum-level raid for 10 players. The prison once held Illidan Stormrage for 10,000 years, but its dark passages have been opened. Now, players will descend into the fabled prison to learn what became of those left behind—and how the wardens plan to contain the danger below. Entrances connected to Mount Hyjal, Winterspring, and Blackmaw Hold give raiders multiple paths into Barrow Deeps. Inside, 10-player groups will face eight bosses as they explore the prison’s depths.
